artboards.title: Trip · a day, and the add control

annotations.text:
What the calendar work looks like in the app.

Every value here is lifted from Tokens.swift — the #D1CFA5 page, the #181410 glass at 0.88, Cormorant Garamond for the display face.
The switch is the only place the app asks to READ your calendar. Adding a trip needs the smaller permission and does not come through here.
